latest_action.text: POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - Pursuant to clause 1(c) of rule XIX, the Chair announced further proceedings on H.R. 9237 is postponed.

card.summary: H.R. 9237, titled the "Take Care of America's Veterans Act," addresses a broad range of programs and services administered by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the Department of Defense. The legislation introduces changes to veteran compensation, education and economic opportunity, health care delivery, administrative organization, memorial affairs, and community care standards.

card.summary: S. 4744, the Take Care of America's Veterans Act, is a comprehensive federal bill addressing veterans' benefits, health care, counseling, Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) personnel, infrastructure, and community care programs. It introduces sweeping updates to disability compensation, education benefits, mental health and suicide prevention programs, community care access standards, and VA administrative and acquisition structures.
